payload: {"announcement":{"body":{"en":"The minimum supported version is now r146. Fixes premature reads before the game module is loaded and failure to reacquire a late-loaded base. After driver connection, retries once per second; related reads start only after validating the base, readable ELF image and process identity. Touch sessions remain available while waiting. Settings are preserved; this fix does not tune prediction strength or sensitivity.
